## Summary of Changes

Describe the vulnerability class, SAST/SCA rule, or IaC benchmark added or modified.

## Checklist

- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter is intact and valid YAML.
- [ ] Security checks map to authoritative standards (OWASP, CWE, CIS, NIST/SLSA).
- [ ] Guidance maintains a defensive focus with actionable, framework-appropriate remediations.
- [ ] Context-aware false-positive considerations are noted where applicable.
- [ ] Updated the Audit Coverage Matrix in `README.md` if adding a new audit domain.
